g.text: one stereo Beads; deck A = knobs, deck B = attenuverters
A: pitch (+/-24 st, detents); B: pitch attenuverter
A: size (top = delay mode); B: size attenuverter
A: seed tap (Alt = latch); B: freeze

text.tspan: A: output level (media colour) + time dot; B: input level, cyan when frozen

g.text: A: digital / clean tape / dirty tape; B: Drift = vintage digital
